post.text:
🚌Rainband just in time for the Auckland morning commute!🚇

🌧️The rainband isn't too wide, so a period of rain can be expected followed by some showers, gradually easing with a 'fining up' 🌤️ trend to the rest of the day.

Check your forecast here 👉https://www.metservice.com/national

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
